note: Reads authSafe.content OCTET STRING from the ASN1 tree; the raw content (DER-encoded AuthenticatedSafe) is returned via auth_safe.
Allocates buffer with gnutls_malloc (plain malloc), leaving memory uninitialized beyond what asn1_read_value writes.

asn1_read_value for OCTET_STRING calls asn1_get_octet_der which copies only the content bytes into tmp; if the OCTET STRING content is shorter than the allocated buffer, trailing bytes remain uninitialized.
Passes the buffer (with possible uninitialized tail) to _gnutls_x509_decode_string for BER decoding.
asn1_decode_simple_ber with DECODE_FLAG_HAVE_TAG expects a BER tag; the raw content from step 3 does not start with 0x04 (OCTET STRING tag), so the function fails and returns ASN1_DER_ERROR.
BER decode failure is propagated back; the uninitialized bytes in tmp are never read by the decoder, but the buffer itself remains allocated with uninitialized data.
Error path: auth_safe.data may point to uninitialized memory if _gnutls_x509_read_string partially modified the datum before failing, or the buffer is freed and auth_safe is left dangling.
Subsequent bag parsing reads a value that may have been corrupted or left uninitialized by the earlier failure, leading to a use-of-uninitialized-value.
